work: Room drafts — bridge storm lookout, wet_lab splash bench, dry_lab screen aisle, mess_hall coffee counter, medical_bay bright berth, crew_quarters cabin corridor, editing_room display alcove, engineering_workshop steel tool wall. Portrait drafts — thomas_blake conversational pitch, sarah_morgan square stance, maya_chen gentle explanation, daniel_reyes square stance, olivia_hart gentle listener, lucas_weber conversational gestures. The closest room drafts were dry_lab and editing_room, wet_lab and engineering_workshop, and medical_bay and crew_quarters. I gave the editing room a foreground shoulder and rising cable runs, the workshop a dominant flywheel, and the quarters staggered cabin banks with amber pools. The closest portrait drafts were thomas_blake and lucas_weber, sarah_morgan and daniel_reyes, and maya_chen and olivia_hart. I turned Lucas sideways with a framing gesture, curved Daniel around a familiar fitting, and seated Olivia with crossed hands and an upward gaze. On the second pass, the largest room overlaps were two axes each for wet_lab and crew_quarters, wet_lab and engineering_workshop, dry_lab and crew_quarters, dry_lab and engineering_workshop, and medical_bay and crew_quarters. Their dominant shapes are distinct. Portrait overlaps dropped to one axis each for Thomas and Maya, Thomas and Daniel, Thomas and Olivia, Sarah and Maya, Sarah and Daniel, Maya and Daniel, Maya and Lucas, and Daniel and Lucas. Each portrait has its own silhouette and posture.

rooms.description: From the threshold, a broad wing window catches a breaking wave in grey wash. Opposite, inked navigation and radar housings sit below a weather display. The log shelf has a clipped pad beside the docked radio.
rooms.feeling: The thumb-polished clip on the log pad suggests a steady watch even as the sea appears to climb the glass.

rooms.description: Look down across a diagonal splash trough between bolted steel benches. Overhead strips catch spray from the sampler. Black water lines feed fixed pumps above ribbed flooring, and teal caps mark bottles locked into racks.
rooms.feeling: The orderly run of capped bottles makes the spray and pump vibration feel like routine work.

rooms.description: From the rear corner, square ceiling tiles and bolted desks recede toward an angled monitor wall. Grayscale plots glow at the far end, and a blue clip holds a page of inked diagrams against a workstation rail.
rooms.feeling: The clipped page is crowded with corrections in a room so still the screen glow feels suspended.

rooms.description: From bench height, an amber pendant washes the long, rectangular bolted table. Chipped mugs hang in sprung clips above the strapped coffee urn. A latched refrigerator and pinned snapshots crowd the narrow galley behind.
rooms.feeling: The chipped mugs make the galley feel like home even with a latch on the refrigerator.

rooms.description: A broad exam light washes the narrow upright backrest of a bolted bed. Flush cabinet latches flank it. Beside the diagnostic screen's green indicator, a report sheet sits under a spring bar on the wall desk.
rooms.feeling: A hand-worn spring bar on the report desk gives the ship’s brightest room the discretion of a private conversation.

rooms.description: Three cabin doors punctuate one wall, four sit in staggered recesses opposite, and the eighth closes the short passage. Ceiling downlights pick out tall jambs, a yellow handrail and wool socks clipped above a scuffed threshold.
rooms.feeling: Wool socks drying above one threshold give the tightly ordered passage the intimacy of somebody’s bedroom.

rooms.description: Frame one edge with a shoulder. Violet tape marks charging leads rising through clips across an old chart rail. A strapped laptop and dual monitors light pinned shot sketches, rack-held cameras and headphones clipped flat.
rooms.feeling: The pinned shot sketches make the ship’s darkest room feel like a place where someone is trying to see clearly.

rooms.description: A spoked pump flywheel stands upright in a floor-bolted cradle, its rim white under a strip work light. Behind it, red tool clips frame a maintenance terminal, strapped test meter, latched parts drawers and pinned diagrams.
rooms.feeling: A single polished spoke shows where a mechanic keeps checking the fit in a workshop that rattles around it.

people.description: A broad, square man in his forties leans back. Hard light picks out a cleft chin, swept black hair and the yellow zip of his fitted pullover. He angles a wrist-looped tablet toward you, meeting your eyes.
people.feeling: He turns his tablet toward you as if a crisis were a pitch, with the wrist loop twisted tight around his hand.

people.description: A tall, straight-backed woman in her fifties wears a navy bridge uniform, its blue cuffs sharply rim-lit. A long grey braid falls beside her weathered, freckled face. Her hands hang as she looks sideways toward the speaker.
people.feeling: She holds a captain’s straight-backed stance and listens with her fingers loose at her sides until the speaker finishes.

people.description: A softly rounded woman in her thirties leans in, her copper-orange shirt cuff emerging from a knit vest. A black ponytail brushes her collar. In soft wash, her dimple shows as two fingers mark a precise gap.
people.feeling: She makes a measurement easy to follow with two fingers, holding them rigidly in place even as she smiles.

people.description: A lean man in his late fifties curves over a tethered coupling. Terminal glow catches his heavy brow, clean jaw and close black waves. Grease streaks his canvas vest beside a red tab as his thumb finds the seam.
people.feeling: His thumb finds the coupling seam by feel from years on the apparatus, with a delicate touch at odds with the set of his jaw.

people.description: A narrow-shouldered woman with broad hips sits in a pool of light, wrists crossed low over a fitted charcoal cardigan. Her tightly braided black hair frames a long, dark face with a small chin. She looks up, lips parted.
people.feeling: She lifts her eyes at the first pause and lets it stretch even with her lips parted to speak.

people.description: A compact, muscular man in his late twenties twists sideways in a loose overshirt with violet stitching. Monitor glow catches his straight black fringe and crooked smile. He looks off-frame, setting two fingers at the corners of an imagined shot.
people.feeling: His shoulders are already turning toward the next conversation while his fingers hold the frame perfectly still.
